title: Week07 · Problem04 — Iterator & Mediator
description: 입장·퇴장하는 팀원에게 순서대로 메시지를 전달하는 채팅방을 구현합니다. 참여자 간 직접 참조 없이 Mediator와 Iterator를 사용합니다.

tests.title: 기본 메시지와 목록
tests.input:
4
JOIN ana
JOIN bob
SEND ana hello
LIST
tests.output:
JOINED ana
JOINED bob
bob<-ana: hello
MEMBERS ana,bob

tests.title: 입장 순서와 재입장
tests.input:
8
JOIN c
JOIN a
JOIN b
SEND a hi
LEAVE c
JOIN c
SEND b done
LIST
tests.output:
JOINED c
JOINED a
JOINED b
c<-a: hi
b<-a: hi
LEFT c
JOINED c
a<-b: done
c<-b: done
MEMBERS a,b,c

tests.title: 중복과 없는 참여자
tests.input:
5
JOIN a
JOIN a
LEAVE x
SEND x hello
LIST
tests.output:
JOINED a
ERROR duplicate
ERROR missing
ERROR missing
MEMBERS a

tests.title: 빈 방과 혼자 있는 방
tests.input:
6
LIST
SEND ghost msg
JOIN lone
SEND lone hi
LEAVE lone
LIST
tests.output:
MEMBERS -
ERROR missing
JOINED lone
NO_RECEIVERS
LEFT lone
MEMBERS -

tests.title: 발신자 제외와 탈퇴 반영
tests.input:
6
JOIN a
JOIN b
SEND b one
SEND a two
LEAVE a
SEND b three
tests.output:
JOINED a
JOINED b
a<-b: one
b<-a: two
LEFT a
NO_RECEIVERS

tests.title: 재사용한 이름과 연속 목록
tests.input:
8
JOIN z
JOIN y
LEAVE z
JOIN z
LIST
SEND z v_2
LEAVE y
LIST
tests.output:
JOINED z
JOINED y
LEFT z
JOINED z
MEMBERS y,z
y<-z: v_2
LEFT y
MEMBERS z
